VERIFICATION PERFORMED (did not assume from the shared bare domain -- explicitly tested for a US locale/catalogue split per the S.N. 138 Anthropologie UK counter-precedent): (1) NO LOCALE PATHS -- https://www.muuto.com/en-us/, /us/, and /en-US/products/lighting/floor-lamp/ all return HTTP 302 with an EMPTY Location header (a dead-end bounce, not a locale rewrite); no /en-us/, /us/, or any country-prefixed URL exists. (4) SITEMAP -- https://www.muuto.com/sitemap.xml lists 576 URLs and not one carries a country/locale prefix (first-path-segment census: product 376, content 71, sofa-experience 28, lighting-guide 25, ar 15, etc.); a single flat global URL space. (5) PRICING IS EUR ONLY -- every product returned by the /api/products endpoint across all 8 tested categories is priced 'EUR <n>,00'; no USD appears anywhere on the site. (6) IDENTICAL PER-CATEGORY COUNTS -- re-ran the same same-origin /api/products?pageId=<id> endpoint c184 used and got byte-for-byte the same distinct-master-product counts as c184 recorded, across ALL of its 9 leaves: Floor Lamps 21679 hits=7, Pendant Lamps 21505 hits=20, Table Lamps 21736 hits=14, Wall Lamps 21809 hits=9, Mirrors 20406 hits=4, Vases 21060 hits=4, Candleholders 21839 hits=2, Hangers/Coat Hooks 20407 hits=7, Kitchen 21333 hits=9 (inflated totalHits SKU/variant subtotals also reproduced identically: 11/20/18/17/4/4/4/7/9). Same catalogue, same assortment, same product IDs, no US variant. CONCLUSION: muuto.com serves ONE global English catalogue with EUR pricing; the 'Muuto US' roster row is the same site as S.N. 184 and contributes no additional categories or quantities. SIDE FINDING RELEVANT TO S.N. 255 (Design Within Reach): Muuto's actual US retail presence is NOT on muuto.com -- https://us.muuto.com/ 301/302-redirects to https://www.dwr.com/brands-muuto, exactly mirroring the S.N. 28 HAY US precedent noted in the brief (us.hay.com -> dwr.com/brands-hay). So Muuto's US assortment lives as a brand subset inside DWR's catalogue (S.N. 255 in this window), not as a separate muuto.com US storefront -- the S.N. 255 worker should expect a Muuto-branded overlap there in addition to the flagged HAY one. Other candidate US hosts checked and dead: shop.muuto.com and usa.muuto.com both fail to connect (wildcard DNS, no TLS listener); muuto.us does not resolve/connect.
